scene: The machine clatters, spitting tickets pointing toward three waiting rides outside.
picture: Side-scrolling view under starry skies. On the far left, a hanging metal book cart lift dangles from cables. Next, the coin machine spits tickets beside the player in his straw hat and red poncho. In the centre, a purple night bus idles. On the far right waits a pedal-powered bicycle rickshaw.
shown: a dangling open book cart lift hanging empty on the far left
a sleek purple night bus idling with doors open in the centre
